title: Too much blank space in panel popup
line: A panel Timer's popup now opens at its normal compact size after a Plasma restart, instead of a huge popup that is mostly empty.
explanation: Applet popups remember their size: AppletPopup saves popupWidth/popupHeight on every hide and pins the popup to that size after a restart. Qt also sends hide events to a popup that was never shown, which happens while a newly added applet switches from its inline full view to the panel icon, so the Timer stored its unshown popup size (560x400) before anyone opened it. After a Plasma restart the popup opened at that size: a huge popup with one thin progress bar. The change saves the size only if the popup was really shown since the last hide; sizes set by the user resizing the popup are still kept.

commits.message:
AppletPopup: don't save the size of a popup that was never shown

Qt also sends hide events to popups that were never shown, so a newly
added applet saved whatever size its unshown popup had, and after a
restart its popup opened at that size. Only save the size once shown.

BUG: 488937

review.text: Clean one-line fix in TimerView.qml that keeps the editable timer digits visible in panel popups regardless of showRemainingTime, while leaving desktop timers and the compact panel representation untouched. This eliminates the nearly empty popup with only a thin progress bar and aligns with the open MR !1235 and the timer configuration rework !1242. Before/after screenshots confirm the panel still shows only the progress bar while the popup now displays usable digits.

reviews.text: Clean one-line fix in TimerView.qml that keeps the editable timer digits visible in panel popups regardless of showRemainingTime, while leaving desktop timers and the compact panel representation untouched. This eliminates the nearly empty popup with only a thin progress bar and aligns with the open MR !1235 and the timer configuration rework !1242. Before/after screenshots confirm the panel still shows only the progress bar while the popup now displays usable digits.

Both earlier requests are resolved. The oversized popup after a restart was traced (gdb) to AppletPopup saving popupWidth/popupHeight on hide events that Qt sends to a popup that was never shown, and the fix only saves after a real show. That is the right generic layer (the analog clock was hit too), it is tiny, and user resizes are still kept. The Timer half is already in kdeplasma-addons master (94a967757, which carries BUG: 488937), so with this commit the reporter's step 5 is covered too; before-2/after-2 show the 560x400 popup becoming compact after a restart. Sizes already saved by the bug stay in old configs, which is unavoidable and documented.

history.text: Showing the digits in the panel popup whatever 'Show remaining time' says is the right UX: the popup becomes useful and you can set the time there. It is a clean one-line change in TimerView, and the screenshots prove it on first open. But the reporter's steps end with 'Restart to finalize the layout, then click on the timer widget again', and the fixer's own notes say that after a plasmashell restart the popup reopens at a stored 560x400 size with huge digits and a lot of empty space below. That is still 'too much blank space in panel popup' in the exact scenario reported, so the bug isn't fully closed.

history.summary: The oversized popup after a restart was a libplasma bug: AppletPopup saved its size on hide events Qt sends to a popup that was never shown, so a new Timer stored 560x400 before anyone opened it. Revision 2 is one libplasma commit that only saves the size after a real show. The Timer one-liner was dropped because kdeplasma-addons master already has it (94a967757).

answers.request: Fix the popup reopening at the oversized stored size (560x400) after a plasmashell restart, or show that it is a generic Plasma popup-size issue handled elsewhere, so the panel popup stays compact after the restart in the reporter's step 5.
answers.answer: Done in libplasma (AppletPopup::showEvent sets a flag, hideEvent only saves popupWidth/popupHeight if the popup was shown since the last hide). gdb showed the 560x400 came from hide events sent by the QML visible binding while a new applet switches from its inline full view to the panel icon; nothing was ever shown. With the fix nothing is stored on add, and after a plasmashell restart the popup opens at 360x145 with the digits, and again after a second restart. It is generic (the analog clock got the same 560x400), so the fix is in libplasma, not the Timer. A popup the user resized still keeps its size after a restart.
